categories.main_business_segments: KE Holdings Inc. operates five main business segments: existing home transaction services, new home transaction services, home renovation and furnishing, home rental services, and emerging and other services including financial services. The company provides brokerage services for existing and new home sales, home rentals, home renovation and furnishing services, and other housing-related services through its integrated online and offline platform, Beike.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a cloud-based technology infrastructure supporting the entire housing transaction lifecycle, including AI applications, virtual reality (RealSee VR), SaaS systems for agents and stores, and digital transaction service centers. It employs AI-driven tools such as ChatHome and DreamHome for customer and service provider support, and uses a proprietary Agent Cooperation Network (ACN) to standardize and streamline agent collaboration and commission allocation. The home renovation segment uses a digital platform called Home SaaS integrating BIM and AI for design and construction management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KE Holdings serves housing customers including home buyers, sellers, landlords, and tenants, as well as real estate brokerage brands, stores, agents, real estate developers, and home renovation and rental service providers. Its major end markets are residential housing transactions and services in China, including existing and new home sales, rentals, renovation, and related financial services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with extensive coverage across numerous cities. Its platform includes over 51,000 stores and approximately 500,000 agents nationwide. The report does not specify operations outside China, indicating a focus on the Chinese housing market.
categories.supply_chain_position: KE Holdings operates primarily as a platform provider and service facilitator in the midstream and downstream segments of the housing industry supply chain. It connects housing customers with brokerage agents, developers, and service providers, facilitating transactions and related services rather than engaging in upstream property development, except for limited land acquisitions under its Beihaojia initiative.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in AI, virtual reality, and digital infrastructure to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI-driven applications for consumers, service providers, and internal efficiency, as well as developing scalable SaaS systems and transaction support platforms. Strategic initiatives include expanding home renovation and rental services, enhancing agent cooperation through ACN, and developing data-driven residential development services via Beihaojia.
categories.revenue_model: KE Holdings generates revenue through commissions on existing and new home transactions, platform and franchise service fees from brokerage firms, home renovation and furnishing service fees, rental property management and operation fees, and emerging services including financial services. Revenue streams include direct sales commissions, service fees, franchise fees, and value-added services across its integrated platform.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from other online housing transaction platforms, traditional offline real estate brokerage firms, new home marketing service providers, and housing-related service companies in China. KE Holdings positions itself as the leading integrated online and offline platform in China’s housing transactions and services industry, leveraging its extensive agent network, authentic property listings, technology infrastructure, and brand recognition, particularly through its Lianjia brand.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, KE Holdings reported net revenues of RMB93.5 billion, a 20.2% increase from 2023, with a gross transaction value of RMB3,349.4 billion. The company facilitated over 4.9 million housing transactions in 2024. It has a large operational scale with over 135,000 employees and a broad agent and store network. While net income decreased to RMB4.1 billion in 2024 from RMB5.9 billion in 2023, adjusted net income remained strong at RMB7.2 billion, reflecting ongoing growth and scale in its core businesses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KE Holdings offers a comprehensive, integrated platform combining online and offline services that streamline housing transactions and related services in China. Its unique Agent Cooperation Network fosters collaboration and specialization among agents, enhancing service quality and efficiency. The company differentiates through authentic property listings, advanced AI and VR technologies, extensive agent training, and a broad ecosystem that includes brokerage, renovation, rental, and financial services, providing one-stop residential solutions and superior customer experience.
